answer: In the dead of night the icefall night-watchman patrols the serac lane with the lantern low, chalks the safe line on the ice wall and rings the bell at each turning before the dawn party wakes. The patrol is kept by Summit snowfork mapper mast certificate: a certificate snowfork mappers file after mast gauge checks. The karst chalks the line, the ripple rings the bell, the reef patrols the lane. A missed bell passed off as rung costs 5309 false chalks and 5309 false bells to stage.
